violatedPolicies.description: Alert on deployments with curl present
violation: Image includes component 'curl' (version 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8)
violatedPolicies.remediation: Use your package manager's "remove", "purge" or "erase" command to remove curl from the image build for production containers. Ensure that any configuration files are also removed.

violatedPolicies.name: Docker CIS 4.1: Ensure That a User for the Container Has Been Created
violatedPolicies.description: Containers should run as a non-root user
violation: Image has user 'root'
violatedPolicies.remediation: Ensure that the Dockerfile for each container switches from the root user

violatedPolicies.name: Required Image Label

violatedPolicies.remediation: Request that the maintainer add the required label to the image.

violatedPolicies.name: Ubuntu Package Manager in Image
violatedPolicies.description: Alert on deployments with components of the Debian/Ubuntu package management system in the image.
violation: Image includes component 'apt' (version 2.8.3)
Image includes component 'dpkg' (version 1.22.6ubuntu6.5)
violatedPolicies.remediation: Run `dpkg -r --force-all apt apt-get && dpkg -r --force-all debconf dpkg` in the image build for production containers.
